top_signal.title: burnout
top_signal.summary: I’ve read the tips for managing burnout but I just need to vent that I am burnt out. Even with having more time off I have no motivation to work in or on my business. Business is small and doing well. Im just bored of doing the same thing for 6 years. Financially, I am able to step back and let others work in the business for me. Any recommendations for how long I should do that in hopes I’ll get my mojo back? I know it’s hard to say but looking for experience from others in the same boat. Thanks :)        submitted by     /u/Accomplished_Bite685       [link]       [comments]
